mlm:name: SenPa-MAE
description: SenPa-MAE is a transformer-based masked autoencoder for multi-satellite self-supervised pretraining, incorporating sensor parameter encoding to enable sensor-independent Earth observation foundation models.
masking_strategy: Random masking of 66% of tokens (patch-channel tokens)
pretraining: Self-supervised masked autoencoding with sensor parameter encoding and spectral superposition augmentation across Sentinel-2, Planet SuperDove, and Landsat-8/9 imagery.
domain_knowledge: Sensor parameter encoding (spectral response function, ground sampling distance)
backbone_modifications: Sensor parameter encoding module (MLPs for spectral response and GSD)

mlm:input.name: Sentinel-2, Planet SuperDove, Landsat-8, Landsat-9
bands: All 10m and 20m GSD bands of Sentinel-2

sampling: Random sampling of 50k patches (S2, SD), 25k patches (LS) from 29 locations; 4 random channels per image
processing:lineage: Resample all images to 5m pixel-spacing grid

mlm:hyperparameters.patch_size: 9x9 patch pattern per channel, 4 channels per image
augmentations: Resolution augmentation (random cubic downsampling with Gaussian blur)

regions: United States (9 locations, 5 for training, 4 for validation)
benchmarks.split_ratio: 5 train locations / 4 validation locations; samples used: 42000 of 42000 (100%)
